params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Aatrox''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|{{pplevel|key=%|4 to 10}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|100 to 320}} against {{tip|monsters}}. ''Deathbringer Stance's'' damage applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.

'''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, reduced to {{ap|0.25*1.0*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
params.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}} with a basic attack {{tip|on-hit}} or an {{tip|ability}}, ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 2 seconds, doubled to 4 if he hits with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of ''{{ai|The Darkin Blade|Aatrox}}''.
params.notes:
* '''Aatrox''' will assume stance when an enemy champion is in range of {{ai|Infernal Chains|Aatrox}}.
** The [[Emoting|toggle]] expression (default {{sbc|CTRL + 5}}) switches between stances manually.
* If ''Deathbringer Stance's'' empowered attack becomes available during a standard attack's windup, it will not be consumed or trigger the '''bonus''' damage.
* The cooldown reduction applies even if an ability's hit is countered by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* If available upon death, ''Deathbringer Stance'' begins incurring its cooldown, but becomes available upon respawn.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, {{cis|Aatrox}} next {{tip|basic attack}} deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{as|{{sti|healing}}}} him for the damage dealt.
params.blurb2: '''Aatrox's''' basic attacks and {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} {{sti|ah|reduce}} ''Deathbringer Stance's'' {{sti|cd|cooldown}}.

params.name: The Darkin Blade
params.description: '''Aatrox''' can activate ''The Darkin Blade'' three times before the ability goes on cooldown, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. If '''Aatrox''' does not recast the ability within 4 seconds of the previous cast, it goes on cooldown.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs a strike with his greatsword for each of the three casts, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit within an area. Enemies hit within a {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} of the area take {{ccs|75% '''bonus''' damage|physical}} and are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Each subsequent cast gains {{ap|0.25*100}}% more damage.
params.description3: {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' first strike affects a 625{{times}}180-unit rectangular area in the target direction, with him centered on the back line and the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge.
params.leveling3: {{st|First Cast Damage|{{ap|10 to 70}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60 to 90}}% AD)}}|First Sweetspot Damage|{{ap|10*1.75 to 70*1.75}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*1.75 to 90*1.75}}% AD)}}}}
params.description4: {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' second strike affects a trapezoidal area in the target direction, with the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} at the farthest edge. The hitbox begins 100-units behind '''Aatrox''' and extends 475-units in front of him, measuring between 300 and 500-units wide from behind to in front.
params.description5: {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox's''' third strike affects a 300-radius circular area centered on a target location that is 200 units in front of him, with a 180-radius {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} within.
params.description6: ''The Darkin Blade'' deals {{pp|55 to 70|key=%|1;6;11;16|formula=55% base + 5% every 5 levels thereafter}} damage against {{tip|minions}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, the first cast deals {{as|25 '''bonus''' physical damage}}, which is affected by the subsequent cast and {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} damage modifiers; and the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration from hitting the {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} against them is doubled to {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.cdstart: Cooldown starts on first cast and restarts on each successive recast
params.notes:
[[File:Aatrox hitbox areas.png|thumb|The ability's area of effect consists of two shapes, different for each cast - the {{as|Sweetspot}} is the part where two areas overlap (See {{tip|er|edge range}} and {{tip|cr|center range}}).]]
* The first and second casts function like any point-blank AOE (ground/area effect centered at or offset to the caster). An enemy is considered to be hit by them based on {{tip|er|edge range}} - i.e. the hit registers if any part of the enemy's {{tip|gameplay radius}} is within the hitbox.
* The third cast, as well as the {{as|Sweetspot}} of the first and second cast, register their hit based on {{tip|cr|center range}}. The enemy's center must be within the hitbox to apply the effects.
* As implied by the previous point, the {{as|Sweetspot}} for the first and second cast is implemented as separate [[area of effect|areas of effect]] to the main component of the ability. Enemies must be within both areas to trigger the bonus damage, {{tip|airborne|knock up}} and {{ais|Deathbringer Stance|Aatrox}} cooldown reduction.
** The 'target hit successfully' SFX plays whenever an enemy is within the {{as|Sweetspot}} - meaning it is possible to trigger the sound effect without affecting an enemy.
* Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''The Darkin Blade's'' angle of cast is fixed during the cast time, i.e. it maintains its direction in relation to '''Aatrox''' and does not respect any changes in his facing direction.
* If '''Aatrox''' changes his position during ''The Darkin Blade's'' cast, his real facing direction for effects such as {{ai|Petrifying Gaze|Cassiopeia}} is the direction he is moving and not the direction the model is facing.
* '''Aatrox''' cannot declare basic attacks shortly after casting ''The Darkin Blade''.{{bug|2}}<!-- winddown time -->
{{Effect at cast time end}}
{{ct|cast|cast= {{ai|E|Aatrox}} can be cast. Other abilities are disabled.|interrupts=death}}
params.damageextra:
* ''The Darkin Blade's'' damage multipliers {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|stack multiplicatively}} with one another.
* This ability's damage is calculated dynamically each frame based on the caster's current stats.

params.blurb: {{ci|Aatrox}} can cast this ability up to three times in a short amount of time before it goes on {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.blurb2:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' performs an attack with his greatsword in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within an area. The area varies and the damage increases per cast. Enemies within each area's {{as|Sweetspot|sweetspot}} receive increased damage and are briefly {{tip|airborne|knocked up}}.
* [[File: The Darkin Blade.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|First Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' strikes his greatsword in a long rectangle. 
* [[File: The Darkin Blade 2.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|Second Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' slashes his greatsword in a wide trapezoid. 
* [[File: The Darkin Blade 3.png|20px|link=]] {{sbc|Third Cast:}} '''Aatrox''' slams his greatsword in a circle.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' sends a chain in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, doubled against {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}}|Minion Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 70*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|25 to 35}}%}}
params.description2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, a {{tip|tether}} is formed between the target and the ground beneath them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.description3: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, the target is dealt the same {{as|physical damage}} again and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} to the center of the area.
params.notes:
* The impact area is oriented relative to '''Aatrox's''' position when the projectile hits, not where the projectile originated from.
* The location that the target is dragged to is not at the target's original location, but slightly closer towards '''Aatrox's''' position when the zone expires.
<!-- (Uncomment this note if this problem somehow still exists/comes back after V14.4)* There's a small delay in checking if the target is in or outside the ''Infernal Chains'' area. Because of this it is still possible to drag the target if they leave the zone at the last instant. -->
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the chain's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
* This ability's damage is calculated based on the caster's current stats and changes dynamically.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Infernal Chains'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Aatrox''' if he moves during the cast time.
params.tips:
* To succesfully escape when moving in a straight line away from '''Aatrox''' requires at least {{as|628 movement speed| movement speed}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aatrox}} sends a chain in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} the first enemy hit.
params.blurb2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, it creates a {{tip|true sight|revealing}} {{tip|tether|tether}} between them and the ground. If the tether is not broken after a brief moment, they are dealt {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|pulled back}} to the center.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for 16% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.3}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he deals against enemy champions.
params.description3: ''Umbral Dash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Aatrox's''' basic attack timer and can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''
params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|75 - 300|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}|{{tt|500|Maximum extended dash distance across terrain}}}}
params.speed: {{dv|{{tt|800|Dash speed, slightly higher when measured}}|{{tt|1340|Maximum increased dash speed, when dashing through wide terrain}}}}
params.notes:
* The {{tip|dash}} distance can be extended to up-to 500 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
** This may upscale his dash speed so that the dash takes the same total time as the standard maximum-range dash.
* If ''Umbral Dash'' is cast towards a movement command's end point, ''Umbral Dash'' will re-issue a movement command to that point when the dash ends.
** He will be unable to buffer any commands during the dash if it is casted this way. {{bug|1}}
* '''Aatrox's''' model darkens for {{fd|1.5}} seconds upon casting ''Umbral Dash'', which is a remnant of an {{as|attack damage}} buff he received before it got removed in [[V9.9]].
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Aatrox}} {{as|{{sti|heals}}}} for the portion of the damage he deals to champions.
params.blurb4: ''Umbral Dash be cast during other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aatrox''' unleashes his true form for 10 seconds, {{tip|fearing}} nearby enemy {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}} for 3 seconds, during which they are gradually {{tip|slow|slowed}} by up to 99% over the duration. He also gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays by 10% of the '''current bonus''' every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, lasting until ''World Ender'' has ended.
params.description2: Whenever '''Aatrox''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}}, he extends the duration by 5 seconds, up to its original length, and becomes unleashed again.
params.description3: During ''World Ender'', '''Aatrox''' gains {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, has 5% increased [[size]], is {{tip|ghosted}}, and receives increased {{tip|heal|self-healing}} from all sources.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Bonus Attack Damage|{{as|{{ap|20 to 40}}% AD}}}}
{{st|Increased Healing|{{ap|50 to 100}}%}}
params.description4: '''''Aatrox''' can move during World Ender's cast time.''
params.notes:
* His resource bar indicates the remaining duration of ''World Ender''.
* While ''World Ender'' is active, the screen will have a red tint. Near the end of the duration, the tint is intensified.
* ''World Ender'' persists through {{tip|resurrection}} effects.
** ''World Ender's'' healing amplification applies to the health gained by resurrecting.
* ''World Ender'' will cast from wherever '''Aatrox''' is at the end of the cast time.
* Casting ''World Ender'' while it is still active removes the timer on the resource bar. {{bug}}
** If this happens while using {{csl|Aatrox|Primordian}}, the intensified tint effect of ''World Ender'' will stay on the screen for the rest of the game. {{bug}}
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Aatrox}} unleashes his true form for a period, gaining a burst of {{sti|{{as|move speed}}}}. During this time, '''Aatrox''' has increased {{as|{{sti|attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|self-healing}}}}, and is {{tip|ghosted}}.
params.blurb2: These effects are refreshed and the duration is extended whenever '''Aatrox''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}}.
